'''Revelation Ralltiir Operations Classic for ScottGaeta''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 18 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 ROps Revelation DS 2003 Ralltiir.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

My own Ralltiir Ops gone Classic. Don't rate.

== Strategy ==

Deploy the Stormtrooper Garrisons and Biker Scouts from reserve deck. Flip and start winning. Sorry if this is short, but I think it's pretty simple.
